description: This PHP script retrieves MTA log data via a system command, processes the log file, and outputs the log entries in JSON format. It includes session validation and reads log details such as time, level, and description.

methods.name: session_start
methods.description: Starts a new session or resumes an existing one.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes an external command to retrieve log data.

methods.name: file
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file into an array.

methods.name: file_exists
methods.description: Checks if the log file exists.

methods.name: htmlentities
methods.description: Converts characters to HTML entities for safe output.

methods.name: json_encode
methods.description: Encodes PHP data structures into JSON format.

methods.name: header
methods.description: Sends a raw HTTP header to the client.
